common: All other native reptiles and amphibians
official_tier: Keep non-exempt animal licence (non-commercial)
notes: No positive list. Any native species not named above needs a licence, and the Conservator assesses each application against three criteria (NI2024-486 s 2.1): readily sourced from captive-bred animals; basic welfare needs known and manageable; negligible risk to human safety. For reptiles, the unpublished 'Risk Assessment for the Importation of Native Reptiles into the ACT' also applies. Non-local species also need an import licence. Verify with Access Canberra licensing.
